title: Eleusis DMTX retreat and research center in St Vincent and the Grenadines
place_text: St Vincent and the Grenadines, Caribbean

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore says on Jesse Michels's podcast that, besides running DMTX, a programme built around DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, he is helping build a retreat center and a research center in the Caribbean. According to the story, the site is in St Vincent and the Grenadines and dates from 2025, under the name Eleusis. It matters to him because he links the DMT experience to contact with what the episode calls an alien realm, and the center would be a place to study it.
